q1.question: What types of cargo does Lirandzo transport?
q1.answer: We transport general, partial, containerised and special volume cargo. Our fleet is adapted to different goods, from industrial products to consumer goods.

q2.question: How can I track my shipment?
q2.answer: Online: go to the "Track Order" page and enter the tracking code provided at dispatch. The system shows location in real time.

q3.question: What is the delivery time?
q3.answer: It depends on origin, destination and service type. National deliveries take 1–5 business days. International routes may take 5–15 business days.

q4.question: How do I request a quote?
q4.answer: Request a quote on our "Request Quote" page by filling in the cargo details. Our team responds within 24 business hours.

q5.question: Does Lirandzo do international transport?
q5.answer: Yes. We operate strategic international routes, including corridors between Mozambique and South Africa, with customs documentation handled by our team.

q6.question: Is cargo insured during transport?
q6.answer: Yes, all cargo transported by Lirandzo is covered by transport insurance. In case of incident, claims are supported by our team.

q7.question: How can I become a Lirandzo partner?
q7.answer: We are open to new partnerships. Contact us via the contact form or email contato@lirandzo.com with your proposal.

q8.question: Does Lirandzo offer warehousing?
q8.answer: Yes. We have strategic warehouses acting as logistics hubs for consolidation, temporary storage and distribution.

q9.question: How does payment work?
q9.answer: We accept bank transfer, mobile payment and monthly invoicing agreements for regular customers. Payment details are sent with order confirmation.

q10.question: Can I schedule a cargo pickup?
q10.answer: Yes. We offer on-site pickup. Indicate address and preferred time when requesting a quote or contact our operations team.
